results.lastReply:
A VPN is a private tunnel that sends your internet traffic through another computer before it reaches the websites you visit. Namaste, by the way.

Without one, your internet provider and the network you are on (like café Wi-Fi) can see which sites you connect to. With a VPN, they only see scrambled data going to the VPN company. The websites see the VPN's address instead of yours.

People use it for safer public Wi-Fi, for privacy from their provider, or to reach content from another country. It is not magic, though. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust, and it will not protect you from scams or from sites where you are signed in.

VPN ek private raasta hai jo aapka internet traffic pehle doosre computer se guzarta hai, phir websites tak pahunchta hai.

VPN ke bina, aapka internet provider aur café ka Wi-Fi dekh sakte hain ki aap kaunsi sites khol rahe ho. VPN ke saath unhe sirf scrambled data dikhta hai. Websites ko aapke address ki jagah VPN ka address dikhta hai.

Log ise public Wi-Fi par safety, provider se privacy, ya doosre desh ka content dekhne ke liye use karte hain. Ye jaadu nahi hai: VPN company aapka traffic dekh sakti hai, to bharosemand company chuniye. Ye scams se bhi nahi bachata.
